name: Varta
author: ReidenXerx
description: An air raid alert watch for the Ukrainian alert feed, in your bar and across your screen. Picks your oblast, shows a band over everything the moment it goes under alert, and — the part that matters — says just as loudly when it has stopped being able to see the feed. A companion to the official app and the sirens, never a replacement.

barWidget.description: Air raid alerts for your oblast, with an honest 'not watching' state

schema.label: Your region
schema.description: The oblast to watch. Left on detect, this asks two public services once where your address appears to be and only believes an answer both give — pick your region here instead and it never asks at all. The feed reports whole oblasts, so an alert does not mean an alert over your street.

schema.label: Play a sound
schema.description: A short electronic figure, deliberately unlike a real siren so you never have to work out which you heard.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: Struck tones rather than beeps, meant to be noticed without raising your pulse. Glass rings longest, Bell is warm and round, Marimba is the shortest and softest.

schema.label: Repeat the sound every
schema.description: Seconds between repeats while an alert stands. The first one can be missed.
